title: OCRPageRecord
description: One row per physical page extracted via OCR (Vision or Document AI), normalized for loading into the books/chapters/pages pipeline. Engine-agnostic: raw engine responses live in a separate bronze layer, never here.

schema_version.description: Contract version. Bump on any breaking field change.

pipeline_stage.description: Gate field. A page cannot move to 'chunked' (i.e. chunk_record rows may not reference this page_uid) while stage != 'chapter_assigned' or later, and chapter_id must be non-null once stage reaches 'chapter_assigned'. Enforce this in the pipeline, not just in application code, e.g. a CHECK constraint or an assertion in the chunker's input query.

page_uid.description: Natural key: '{book_id}-{page_number}'. Used for idempotent upsert on reruns.

source_file.description: Original PDF filename as ingested, e.g. 'tafhimul_quran_vol1.pdf'.

source_file_hash.description: sha256 of the source PDF bytes. Lets you detect if the same file was re-uploaded/re-OCR'd.

batch_id.description: Ingestion run identifier (e.g. UUID or 'run-2026-09-11-03'). Groups all pages processed together.

ocr_engine_version.description: API/model version string, e.g. 'v1' or processor version id. Needed because OCR quality shifts between model versions.

ingested_at.description: UTC timestamp this record was written, ISO 8601.

chapter_id.description: FK to chapters.id. Null until a chapter-assignment pass runs — OCR has no concept of chapter boundaries on its own.

raw_text.description: Untouched fullTextAnnotation.text (or Document AI document.text) for this page. Kept even after cleaning, for reproducibility.

clean_text.description: raw_text after whitespace normalization / unicode NFC / stray-footnote stripping. Null until the cleaning pass runs.

content_hash.description: sha256 of clean_text. Two pages with the same hash are duplicate content — this is how you catch the Tarun/Nobin cross-DB duplicate-book problem programmatically instead of by eyeballing.

language_detected.description: ISO 639-1/639-3 code, e.g. 'bn', 'ar'. From the OCR engine's language detection.

ocr_confidence.description: Page-level confidence from the OCR engine.

needs_review.description: True if ocr_confidence fell below your review threshold (e.g. 0.85) or has_arabic_script is true. Computed at ingest time, not left for a downstream report.

has_arabic_script.description: Heuristic flag: page contains Arabic-range unicode. Flags candidates for the ayah word-order corruption issue found in the existing corpus.

status.description: Ingestion outcome for this page. 'partial' = OCR ran but confidence/text looks suspect; 'failed' = OCR call errored, raw_text will be empty.
